headline: WNBA Finals 2026 Game 1: Atlanta Dream host Cinderella expansion Valkyries
whyCareReason: Two giant-killers collide in an unprecedented Finals after Dream eliminated Liberty and Valkyries dethroned Aces 3-1.
teaser: Game 1 tips off Thursday, October 15 at 8:00 p.m. ET on ESPN from Gateway Center Arena in College Park.
story: The 2026 WNBA Finals deliver an historic, uncharted matchup as the fourth-seeded Atlanta Dream square off against the expansion Golden State Valkyries. Both teams defied oddsmakers on Sunday, dispatching the two-time reigning finalists in four games: Atlanta eliminated the defending champion New York Liberty 85-83, while the Valkyries stunned the Las Vegas Aces 87-83 in overtime. Golden State becomes the first expansion franchise in professional basketball history to reach a championship series in year one. With Rhyne Howard and Angel Reese leading the Dream against Tiffany Hayes and Veronica Burton, Game 1 sets the tone for an unpredictable best-of-five showdown.
stakes: Game 1 victory delivers vital momentum in the race for the 2026 WNBA championship crown.
rivalryAngle: Atlanta's inside grit and championship hunger meets Golden State's fearless inaugural run.
funFacts: The Golden State Valkyries are the first expansion team across the WNBA, NBA, or ABA to reach the finals in their first season.
The Atlanta Dream are making their fourth finals appearance in franchise history and their first since 2013.
Angel Reese led all semifinalists with an average of 14.8 rebounds per game.

keyPlayers.name: Rhyne Howard
keyPlayers.hook: Poured in 24 points in Sunday's Game 4 clincher against New York.

keyPlayers.name: Tiffany Hayes
keyPlayers.hook: Veteran leader whose overtime heroics against Las Vegas sealed expansion history.

keyPlayers.name: Angel Reese
keyPlayers.hook: Dominant post presence anchoring Atlanta's interior defense.

headToHead: Atlanta and Golden State split their two regular-season meetings 1-1.
